sentiment: A hand draws a car, a bulb thinks, a branch chooses — the machine neither races nor decides; it keeps the shape of being drawn.

stories.title: 2D Vehicles
stories.summary: A collection of hand-drawn 2D vehicles — proof that line work and a little patience still move people more than polygons.

stories.title: The Lightbulb Computer
stories.summary: An odd machine shaped like an idea that never stopped glowing — a reminder that a computer can be a small, single-purpose thing.

stories.title: Build your own decision model
stories.summary: A walkthrough of branching logic you build yourself — every fork is a choice, and choosing is harder than the model suggests.
